The '''Mapuzo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mapuzo/Legends|Mapuzo]],<ref name="Kenobi" /> where a [[Mapuzo break-in|break-in]] occurred<ref name="AIR-33">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> by or in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' describes its events as taking place one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref>
